about_the_game:
"Console Shop Simulator" is a relaxing first-person simulation that brings every detail of running a store to life.

Store Management

Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Decide where CDs and consoles will be displayed, manage your shelves, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers.

Product Supply

Order stock using the in-game computer. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage area, and place them on the appropriate shelves for your products.

Trade

Trade with incoming customers, buy products from them and give other products in return!

License

Buy licenses to access new products, buy and sell. Get rewards by showing your loyalty to license companies!

Employees

Hire employees and pay their salaries so the store can run itself

Customization

Paint your store the way you want, shape your shelves. Decorate the store with LEDs!

Profit

Hunt for discounted items and buy them to save even more!

Online Sale

Listen to online orders and grow your business in the virtual space!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Run your own game store business. Design your shelves with consoles and games, set prices, manage communication with companies, handle customer support, and grow your brand. Online sales, rival companies, marketing strategies, and tech upgrades are coming soon.
supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Czech
